description: Paid ($0.001 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): call this before your agent pays an x402 endpoint. Returns go, caution or no_go, the recommended payment option, and why: payment would fail, the seller's payout address is on the OFAC SDN sanctions list, over your budget (max_usd), price above what is advertised, not HTTPS, unknown token, its 30-day track record. Never pays the endpoint. The buyer's check for one call; for several endpoints at once use x402_preflight_batch, before a payment above about $1 x402_preflight_deep, and to debug your own endpoint x402_diagnose. Same as GET /api/v1/preflight. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

max_usd.description: Your budget per call in USD, e.g. 0.05

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

network.description: CAIP-2 network you want to pay on, e.g. eip155:8453

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_preflight

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

options.description: Each payment option with its network, price and problems

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the answer to your arguments

summary.description: One line, e.g. OK to pay: $0.02 on Base.

verdict.description: go: pay; caution: ask first; no_go: do not pay

title: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it ($0.001 via x402)
